status: prospective inner-development design; does not authorize outer evaluation or holdout access

selection.order: minimum regret window, maximum rank, fewer columns plus nuisance/head parameters, lexical recipe ID
selection.aggregation: mean decisions within component/source/direction, then equal source/direction means over concatenated inner out-of-fold predictions

stability: excluded: both independent frozen validation tests failed; no zero-filled block
bert_choice: pooled fixed-projection CLS+mean mutant minus reference; identical frozen allele function, 128 columns. Contextual edit-window delta is a separately named comparator, never an outer-selected replacement.

processing.interpretation: nuisance proxies, not validated splice or stability predictions
processing.flag_rule: any nonzero donor, acceptor, canonical PAS or common PAS variant delta
processing.flag_policy: inner-only compare keeping all decisions versus abstaining when the top-ranked edit has this flag; report coverage and common-cohort regret; never delete labeled rows or use selective results to replace the full-cohort primary gate

uncertainty.method: three group-bootstrap refits of the selected recipe; within-decision percentile-rank standard deviation
uncertainty.selection: inner-only, minimum covered regret within 0.002 tolerance then greater coverage
uncertainty.primary_gate: always full coverage; selective utility is secondary

controls.donor_unit: unique feature_row intervention, not replicated candidate rows
controls.singletons: ineligible for matched null comparison; never cycle donors
controls.N10: not applicable: independently trained stability block excluded

inference: shared source-free latent score only; reverse its sign for decrease. Optional source temperatures are training heads, not assay-value calibration.
holdout: sealed; no authorization in this design
